title: Stage 1 to Stage 4 Cancer means - DM (AIIMS) - Cancer Stage and Grade in Hindi 2020
description: What are the stages of cancer? How many stages are there in which cancer? What does the last stage mean? Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4 What does Cancer mean? How is the stage of cancer detected? How long does the patient live in which cancer stage? What is the difference in cancer stage and grade? How is treatment in different stage cancer? How are the stages of breasts, lungs, liver, bone, brain, colon, intestine, urine sac, stomach, ovaries, tests, gadud etc.?  Learn from Delhi's famous Cancer Specialist Medical Oncologist Dr. Vineet Govinda Gupta MBBS (AIIMS), MD (AIIMS), DM (AIIMS), Gold Medalist.  If you have any questions other than this video, then contact us with WhatsApp, video comments, emails. Subscribe to the channel. asr.full_text: Almost every cancer patient knows that each stage of a cancer has different stages and each stage has its own treatment and different prognoses Do any of you know how many stages are there of cancer and what are its prognoses Hello My name is Dr Vineet Govinda Gupta MBBS MD and DN from Ames, New Delhi and I work in Delhi as a cancer specialist So friends, on the last conductive poll of our channel many of you have voted on today's topic If you also want to vote for this video that is very big for Cancer and for another video in our next video please do subscribe to our channel and also click on the bell icon So today's topic is stages of cancer and And in today's video, we will discuss all those questions Which we are called to ask about Cancer Stages What is the meaning of Stage of cancer? And what are the stages of the cancer? The stages of stage one, two, three and four What are the implications? And what is the difference in stage and grade? How much survival is expected in each of these stages And what are the main topics where the survival depends? So, let us first discuss what we mean by cancer stage Cancer stage is one of the cancer. Number one is how much cancer is spread out in the body. as cancer is spreader over your bg organs as it does that the stage of cancer increases in our body. other thing the states of the stage of cancer are that what is the prognosis of cancer as the stage of cancer increases cancer survival decreases and there is less chance of survival. where we get the staging The more this stage progress through which the survival of cancer decreases hence patient are lower option to survive From where do the stages come? Staging in an evolving process Although cancer stage would not be the same after 10 years Various organisation like American Joint Committee of Cancer International Federation of Ongology and gynecology etc these women cancer patient's staging is made which we do under oncologist clearing So how many cancer stage are there ? many people believe that cancer has four stages but i want to clarify that cancer stages depends on the type of the cancer in some cancer there are two or three stage for example, in some special type of cancer there are only two stages and in testicular cancer there are only three stages on the another hand, there are more stages in some cases for example in some cancer there might be more stages than 5 stages in some cancer there might go 5 or more than 5 stages From cancer to cancer, exact number of stages varies but in majority of cancers, stage 1, stage 2, stage 3 & stage 4 The next question is, from stage 1, Stage 2 and Stage 3 and Stage 4 So friends, if we talk about any cancer, then Stage 1, 2, 3 and 4 are the sequence of the spread of a basic cancer For example when we talk about breast cancer then there are very small tumours in the breast that are only localised in the breast Similarly, other cancers like lung cancer, prostate cancer stage I typically causes a small tumor which is usually confined in the organs stage II shows 2 categories of tumor either the tumor is of some size bigger size but still is confined in the organs or the tumor starts bending slightly that is organ is removed or starting to pop out or is getting stuck inside the organ nodes Stage 3 in general is called locally advanced disease Locally advanced diseases mean that cancer has popped out of the organ but, its present on local site Here examples would be breast cancer that has spread on shoulder nodes lung cancer that has spread in shoulder nodes Lung cancer which has spread in the middle of chest Prostate Cancer which has started to touch the surface of the prostate or Coilin Cancer which has moved to the lymph node near the coil That means Cancer have started to come out of the organ of origin And have started not to spread in the part of distant organ like lung, liver, brain and bone Stage IV Meaning of Advanced or metastatic cancer is the stage 4 cancer that is been spread through the organs from far away for example, that which ever type of body cancer be that lung, breast, colon prostate, or any other type spread in the bones or in the liver , or in the brain so that is as Stage 4 cancer so it means that cancer is caused from the organs and in the distant side Next question which is commonly asked is What is the difference between Stage & Grade For example in the biopsy report patients often find out that cancer is in the Grade level- 2 or 3 and they confuse it with a stage. So guys, stage and grade are two different things Stages, as we discussed earlier, indicate how much the cancer is in the biopsy. And grade is a field of biopsy that tells us that how fast the tumour cells divide and at what rate they grow and multiply. So stage and grade are different. Stage one cancer can be grade 3 the patient's growth and multiplication. Stage and grade may be different. Stage 1 can be grade 3 and in stage 4, so the patient has different information about treat of cancer by these 2 factors. Next question frequently asked is how much the patients survive in each stage. This is a very important question and I want to discuss this with clarity That is that, Stage is not the only issue that decides how long the patient will live The survival of a patient is dependent on a number of factors At the very best the question is how is the cancer Let' us take an example. If somebody has stage two or three pancreas most importantly what sort of cancer we are talking about for example if someone has stage 2 or 3 pancreas cancer so his survival is less than stage 4 low grade tumour i.e one slow growing tumour can have longer survival while fast growing tumour have low survival similarly we have other test that test a patient's survival However, a far growing tumor could survive less. Similarly, there are other map-tents which show us how much people survive. Along with all these information, we make a fine-tune of survival. Common things dictate survival for a patient are Cancer type, Grade ie. How aggressive a cancer is, Stage or , It's stage and its health is How good is cancer treatment There can be no n organ failure in cancer And Biomarkers and molecular biology Biomarkers and molecular biology is all about that are in some cancers only that consists of molecular subgroups including slow growing, fast growing tumor have different pigments It is also important to learn about the treatments available for biologic tumor By understanding all this we can take approximate survival rate of a patient but more importantly together we can consider it as a patient of approximately a survival rate But the important thing is average is still just an average and it can happen either more or less than average in any cancer type So friends that's it for today's video we hope that you have enjoyed our episode Our purpose of the channel is so today's video is ending we hope you found it useful purpose of our channel is to offer the latest information on cutting edge cancer treatments to Indian patients so that he can access if you find this to be useful then please share , like and share our video our channel release new videos every month video selection generally depends on our audiences choice in our channel we get lot of polls audience can decide their own video In last poll, the most popular choice was cancer stage so today's video is about it If you wanna participate in our next video subscribe our channel Thank you and let's run
